dominate the market: With over 70 percent of all sales, the company continues to dominate the market for electric scooters in Taiwan.
這家公司占了七成以上的銷售量，持續稱霸台灣的電動機車市場。
dominate the conversation: My uncle always tries to dominate the conversation at family dinners, so nobody else gets a chance to speak.
我叔叔在家庭聚餐時總想主導談話，所以其他人都沒有機會說話。
dominate the headlines: The typhoon dominated the headlines for days, and every news channel kept reporting on the damage it caused.
那個颱風連續好幾天占據頭條，每個新聞台都不斷報導它造成的災情。
dominate the game: Our basketball team dominated the game from start to finish and won by more than thirty points.
我們的籃球隊從頭到尾主宰比賽，以超過三十分的差距獲勝。
donate blood: Every month, many students donate blood at the hospital to help patients who need surgery.
每個月都有許多學生到醫院捐血，幫助需要動手術的病人。
donate money to charity: Instead of buying birthday gifts, she asked her friends to donate money to charity for homeless children.
她請朋友們不要買生日禮物，而是捐款給幫助街友兒童的慈善機構。
donate organs: More people are now willing to donate organs after death, which gives hope to thousands of waiting patients.
現在有更多人願意在死後捐贈器官，這給了數千名等待中的病人希望。
double as a bedroom: Our tiny study has two uses: it is my office by day, and it can double as a bedroom when guests stay over.
我們的小書房有兩種用途：白天是我的辦公室，有客人過夜時還能兼作臥室。
double the effort: If we want to finish the project before Friday, we will have to double the effort we put in each day.
如果我們想在星期五前完成這個專題，就得把每天投入的心力加倍努力。
prices doubled: Because of the poor harvest, vegetable prices doubled in just two weeks, and many families had to buy less.
由於收成不佳，菜價在短短兩週內翻倍，許多家庭只好少買一些。
double back: We realized we had taken the wrong road, so we had to double back to the last gas station.
我們發現走錯路了，只好折返回上一個加油站。
double-check: Before you hand in your test paper, remember to double-check your answers for careless mistakes.
交考卷之前，記得再次確認你的答案有沒有粗心的錯誤。
draft a letter: I spent an hour trying to draft a letter of complaint, writing and rewriting the first paragraph many times.
我花了一個小時試著起草一封投訴信，第一段寫了又改、改了又寫好幾次。
draft a plan: The city government has started to draft a plan for reducing traffic, and it will be finished by next spring.
市政府已開始擬定一份減少交通流量的計畫，預計明年春天完成。
be drafted into the army: In the past, most young men in Taiwan were drafted into the army after they finished school.
過去台灣大多數年輕男性在完成學業後都會被徵召入伍。
a first draft: I wrote a first draft of my essay last night, but I still need to check the grammar and add examples.
我昨晚寫好了作文的初稿，但還需要檢查文法並加上例子。
drag on for hours: Long meetings often drag on for hours, and by the end, everyone feels tired, hungry, and bored.
冗長的會議常常拖了好幾小時，到最後每個人都又累、又餓、又無聊。
drag one's feet: The landlord continues to drag his feet about fixing the broken heater, so we have to stay warm with blankets.
房東修理壞掉的暖氣一直拖拖拉拉，所以我們只好裹著毯子保暖。
drag someone into trouble: I don't want to drag you into trouble, so I will tell the teacher the truth by myself.
我不想把你拖下水，所以我會自己跟老師說實話。
drag down the economy: Many experts worry that rising oil prices could drag down the economy and cause people to lose their jobs.
許多專家擔心油價上漲可能會拖垮經濟，讓人們失去工作。
drag oneself out of bed: On cold winter mornings, I have to drag myself out of bed to catch the early bus to school.
在寒冷的冬天早晨，我得勉強自己起床，才能趕上去學校的早班公車。
drain one's energy: Working long hours in the hot sun can drain your energy quickly, so remember to drink plenty of water.
在大太陽下長時間工作會很快耗盡你的精力，所以記得多喝水。
drain resources: The long war continued to drain resources from the country, leaving little money for schools and hospitals.
長期的戰爭持續耗盡國家的資源，留給學校和醫院的經費所剩無幾。
brain drain: Low salaries have caused a serious brain drain, as many talented doctors move abroad for better jobs.
低薪造成了嚴重的人才外流，許多優秀的醫生出國尋找更好的工作。
drain the pool: The workers had to drain the pool and clean the bottom before it opened again for the summer.
工人們必須先把池水排掉並清理池底，泳池才能在夏天重新開放。
drained after work: She always feels drained after work, so she just wants to eat dinner quietly and go to bed early.
她下班後總是覺得精疲力竭，所以只想安靜地吃完晚餐然後早點睡。
draw a conclusion: It's too early to draw a conclusion, because we have only collected data from a few students.
現在要得出結論還太早，因為我們只收集了少數幾位學生的資料。
draw attention: The bright red sign was designed to draw attention to the new shop on the busy street.
那個鮮紅色的招牌是為了讓繁忙街道上的新店引起注意而設計的。
draw criticism: The new rule on hairstyles is likely to draw criticism from many parents, who think it is unfair to students.
這條新的髮型規定很可能招致許多家長的批評，他們認為這對學生不公平。
draw a crowd: The street performer's amazing tricks always draw a crowd in front of the train station on weekends.
那位街頭藝人的精彩把戲每到週末總會在火車站前吸引人潮。
draw on experience: As a new teacher, she could draw on experience from her years of tutoring to handle difficult students.
身為新老師，她能借助多年家教的經驗來應付難搞的學生。
draw the line: I'm happy to help my friends with homework, but I draw the line at letting them copy my answers.
我很樂意幫朋友寫功課，但在讓他們抄我的答案這件事上，我會劃清界線。
draw a comparison: In his speech, the writer tried to draw a comparison between city life and life in the countryside.
在演講中，那位作家試著將城市生活與鄉村生活做比較。
